question: Estimate the size of India's AI services + AI-as-a-service opportunity by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Indian companies providing AI services + Indian-developed AI products? Yes — Indian market for AI deployed by Indian companies.
Generative AI + traditional ML + AI infrastructure? All.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian enterprise IT spend 2030: ~₹6 lakh Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian enterprise AI spend: ~₹1 lakh Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus AI infrastructure (GPU rentals, data center AI capacity): ~₹30,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian AI market opportunity: ~₹2 lakh Cr (~$24B) by 2030.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: AI/ML allocation as % of IT spend
Plus consumer AI products (chatbots, AI assistants, AI-powered apps)
Plus AI infrastructure (GPU rentals, data center AI capacity)
Plus Indian IT services exporting AI (TCS, Infy, Wipro AI revenue)

calculationFlow: Indian enterprise IT spend 2030: ~₹6 lakh Cr.
Indian enterprise AI spend: ~₹1 lakh Cr.
Plus consumer AI products (chatbots, AI assistants, AI-powered apps): ~₹15,000 Cr.
Plus AI infrastructure (GPU rentals, data center AI capacity): ~₹30,000 Cr.
Plus Indian IT services exporting AI (TCS, Infy, Wipro AI revenue): ~₹50,000 Cr.
Total Indian AI market opportunity: ~₹2 lakh Cr (~$24B) by 2030.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total Indian AI market opportunity: ~₹2 lakh Cr (~$24B) by 2030.
